title: Decoded book-partite edges
statement: For natural numbers $q$ and $k$, and a code in the recursively defined type of perfect-matching codes with parameter $(qk)/2$, the decoded book-partite edges are the list obtained by applying the perfect-matching decoder to that code and the list of book-partite vertices.

caveat: The decoder and the book-partite vertex list are not defined in the supplied snippet, so the construction can only be described by its named inputs and output.
